_about: Skill 78 stop explanations. One entry per stop a client (or, for audience buyer, a buyer) can see. Read by scripts/explain_stop.py; every S78 stop code in scripts/ must have an entry here (tests/test_explain_stop.py fails otherwise). Placeholders in {braces} are filled from the stop's facts; a missing fact uses the entry's defaults, then the shared defaults below. spends_nothing is true only when the check that raises the stop spends no money itself; the message then says so ("This check spent no money." to a client, "You have not been charged." to a buyer). audience is client unless it says buyer.

S78-SINGLE-OFFER-DECLINE.what_happened: Your launch has only one main package, so there is nothing for a buyer to choose between.
S78-SINGLE-OFFER-DECLINE.why: A choose-your-package page with only one choice is a fake choice. It adds an extra step and confuses buyers.
S78-SINGLE-OFFER-DECLINE.fix: Use the simple order form that explains your one package and takes the order on the same page.
choices: I build the one-page order form for your package instead.
You add another real package to the plan, and I build the choose page.

S78-JOURNEY-MODE-DECLINE.what_happened: Your launch plan is set up as {mode}. That kind of launch has no choose-your-package page.
S78-JOURNEY-MODE-DECLINE.why: We build pages from the plan you approved. We never change your plan just to get past a check.
S78-JOURNEY-MODE-DECLINE.fix: Keep your plan and skip this page, or change the plan to "several packages to choose from" and approve it.
choices: I keep your plan as it is and skip the choose page.
I change the plan to several packages and send it to you to approve.
I show you the two kinds of plans side by side so you can pick.

S78-NO-MAIN-OFFERS.what_happened: Your launch has no main packages in it yet, so there is nothing to show.
S78-NO-MAIN-OFFERS.why: A choose page lists your packages. With none, the page would be empty.
S78-NO-MAIN-OFFERS.fix: Add your main packages, with their prices, to the launch plan.
choices: I help you list your packages and prices now.
You send me your packages and prices, and I add them.

S78-OFFER-NO-DELIVERABLES.what_happened: {offer} does not list what the buyer gets.
S78-OFFER-NO-DELIVERABLES.why: Buyers choose by comparing what each package includes. Without that list the page would show prices and nothing else.
S78-OFFER-NO-DELIVERABLES.fix: List what comes with each package. We never make this list up for you.
choices: I ask you what each package includes and add it.
I draft the list from your launch plan and send it to you to check and approve.

S78-NO-COMPARISON-ROWS.what_happened: There is nothing to compare between your packages.
S78-NO-COMPARISON-ROWS.why: Buyers choose by comparing what each package includes. A compare table with no rows would leave them guessing.
S78-NO-COMPARISON-ROWS.fix: List what each package includes, so the table has something to show.
choices: I ask you what each package includes and add it.
I draft the list from your launch plan and send it to you to check and approve.

S78-UNKNOWN-PRICE.why: We never show a missing price as $0 or "free". A buyer would think it costs nothing.
S78-UNKNOWN-PRICE.fix: Give the package its real price and approve it.
choices: I ask you for the price now and add it.
I take that package off this page until it has a price.

S78-UNAPPROVED-PRICE.what_happened: The price for {offer} ({price}) has not been approved yet.
S78-UNAPPROVED-PRICE.why: Only prices you said yes to go on a page buyers can see. That way nobody sees a price you did not agree to.
S78-UNAPPROVED-PRICE.fix: Approve the price, or approve the whole launch plan, which approves every price in it.
choices: I send you this price to approve now.
I send you the whole launch plan to approve.
You give me a different price, and I send that to you to approve.

S78-INVALID-AMOUNT.what_happened: The price for {offer} is written as {amount}, which is not a real price.
S78-INVALID-AMOUNT.why: A price must be a whole amount of money that is zero or more. Anything else could show the wrong number on the page or at checkout.
S78-INVALID-AMOUNT.fix: Fix the price in the launch plan.
choices: I ask you for the correct price and fix it.
I show you where the wrong number is so you can fix it.

S78-DUPLICATE-OFFER-ID.what_happened: {offer} is in your launch plan twice.
S78-DUPLICATE-OFFER-ID.why: Each package must be listed once, so a buyer's choice always goes to the right package.
choices: I remove the extra copy and check again.
I show you both copies so you can say which one to keep.

S78-INSTALLMENT-TOTAL-MISMATCH.what_happened: {offer} is split into {count} payments that add up to {schedule_total}, but its price says {total}.
S78-INSTALLMENT-TOTAL-MISMATCH.why: A buyer must always know the real total. Payments that do not add up to the price would hide the true cost.
S78-INSTALLMENT-TOTAL-MISMATCH.fix: Make the payments add up to the price, or change the price to match the payments.
choices: I change the payments so they add up to the price, and show you.
I change the price to match the payments and send it to you to approve.
You tell me the right numbers, and I fix both.

S78-RECURRING-INTERVAL-MISSING.what_happened: {offer} is a repeating charge, but it does not say how often it repeats.
S78-RECURRING-INTERVAL-MISSING.why: A buyer has to know if they pay every week, month or year before they choose.
S78-RECURRING-INTERVAL-MISSING.fix: Say how often the charge repeats.
choices: I ask you how often it repeats and add it.
I make it a one-time price instead and send it to you to approve.

S78-TRIAL-TERMS-MISSING.what_happened: {offer} has a trial, but the trial rules are not written down.
S78-TRIAL-TERMS-MISSING.why: Trial rules must be shown, never guessed, so a buyer knows what happens when the trial ends.
S78-TRIAL-TERMS-MISSING.fix: Write down the trial rules: how long it lasts and what it costs after that.
choices: I ask you for the trial rules and add them.
I remove the trial and use the normal price.

S78-TEST-ONLY-IN-PRODUCTION.what_happened: {offer} is a test package, but this is your real, live launch.
S78-TEST-ONLY-IN-PRODUCTION.why: Test packages and test prices must never reach real buyers.
S78-TEST-ONLY-IN-PRODUCTION.fix: Take the test package out of the live launch, or run this as a test.
choices: I remove the test package and check again.
I run this as a test instead, so nothing goes live.

S78-MISSING-NATIVE-MAPPING.what_happened: {offer} is not connected to its product and price in your checkout system yet.
S78-MISSING-NATIVE-MAPPING.why: A buyer's choice has to reach the right product and price at checkout. Without that link the buyer could land on the wrong order form, or on none.
S78-MISSING-NATIVE-MAPPING.fix: Set up the product and price in your checkout system, then link them to this launch.
choices: I run the product setup step and link it (I ask your OK before anything is installed).
I list what is missing so you can set it up.

S78-ASSET-PROVENANCE.what_happened: One of the pictures or files listed for this page has no name or no owner.
S78-ASSET-PROVENANCE.why: We only use files whose source we know, so a picture you do not have the right to use never lands on your page.
S78-ASSET-PROVENANCE.fix: Give the file a name and say who owns it, or take it off the list.
choices: I take that file off the list and check again.
You tell me where the file came from, and I add it.

S78-UNPROVEN-CLAIM.what_happened: Your page says {phrase}, and there is no proof for it.
S78-UNPROVEN-CLAIM.why: Words like "most popular", "best value" or "only 50 left" must be true and backed by proof. Claims with no proof can break advertising rules and lose your buyers' trust.
S78-UNPROVEN-CLAIM.fix: Take that line out, or write it without the claim.
choices: I rewrite that line without the claim and show you.
I show you every line with a claim like this, so you can pick new words.

S78-RECOMMENDATION-UNAPPROVED.what_happened: A package is marked "recommended", but no reason is given.
S78-RECOMMENDATION-UNAPPROVED.why: We only recommend a package with a clear reason tied to the buyer, like "for founders who want one-on-one help". A bare "recommended" badge is pushy and unproven.
S78-RECOMMENDATION-UNAPPROVED.fix: Add the reason, or remove the recommendation.
choices: I write a reason for you to approve.
I remove the recommended badge.

S78-COPY-PRICE-MISMATCH.what_happened: The page shows {shown} for {offer}, but the price you approved is {approved}.
S78-COPY-PRICE-MISMATCH.why: A wrong price on the page is never allowed. Buyers must see the exact price they will pay.
S78-COPY-PRICE-MISMATCH.fix: Make the page show the approved price, or approve the new price.
choices: I change the page to your approved price and show you.
I send the new price to you to approve.
I check every price on the page against your plan.

S78-HIDDEN-EXCLUSION.what_happened: Your plan says {offer} does not include {exclusion}, but the page does not say so.
S78-HIDDEN-EXCLUSION.why: Buyers must see what a package leaves out before they choose, on phones too. Hiding it would mislead them.
S78-HIDDEN-EXCLUSION.fix: Add that line to the package's part of the page.
choices: I add the line and show you.
You tell me if that item is really left out, and I update the plan.

S78-AMBIGUOUS-COPY.what_happened: The page says {term} for {offer}, but does not say what it means.
S78-AMBIGUOUS-COPY.why: Fuzzy words like "VIP support" or "and more" hide what the buyer really gets. Each benefit must name the real thing behind it.
S78-AMBIGUOUS-COPY.fix: Say exactly what it means, like "two private review calls", or take it out.
choices: I rewrite it with the real details from your plan and show you.
You tell me what it includes, and I write it.

S78-COMPARE-EMPTY.what_happened: The Compare part of the page is empty.
S78-COMPARE-EMPTY.why: Buyers choose by comparing what each package includes. An empty Compare part makes them choose by price alone.
S78-COMPARE-EMPTY.fix: List what each package includes, so the Compare part has rows.
choices: I ask you what each package includes and add it.
I draft the list from your launch plan and send it to you to check and approve.

S78-MANUSCRIPT-SHAPE.what_happened: The page draft is missing a part, or it lists the packages in the wrong order.
S78-MANUSCRIPT-SHAPE.why: The choose page always has the same five parts and shows your approved packages in order, so buyers can compare them fairly.
S78-MANUSCRIPT-SHAPE.fix: Rebuild the page draft from your approved plan.
choices: I rebuild the draft from your plan and check it again.
I show you what is missing first.

S78-CTA-PAYMENT-LANGUAGE.what_happened: A button on the choose page says "Buy now".
S78-CTA-PAYMENT-LANGUAGE.why: On this page a click only picks a package. Paying happens on the next page, so "Buy now" would tell buyers they are paying when they are not.
S78-CTA-PAYMENT-LANGUAGE.fix: Use button words like "Choose" and the package name.
choices: I change the button words and show you.
You give me the button words you like, and I use them.

S78-PAYMENT-COLLECTION.what_happened: The choose page asks for card details.
S78-PAYMENT-COLLECTION.why: This page never takes payment. Card details are only asked for on the secure order form.
S78-PAYMENT-COLLECTION.fix: Take the card questions off this page.
choices: I take them off and check again.
I move that part to the order form.

S78-SELECTION-UNKNOWN-OFFER.what_happened: {offer} is not one of the approved packages in your launch plan.
S78-SELECTION-UNKNOWN-OFFER.why: Only approved packages can be shown or chosen, so nobody can buy something you never agreed to sell.
S78-SELECTION-UNKNOWN-OFFER.fix: Use one of the approved packages, or add this one to the plan and approve it.
choices: I switch it to one of your approved packages.
I add this package to the plan and send it to you to approve.

S78-SELECTION-PRICE-DRIFT.what_happened: The price or checkout link for {offer} no longer matches what was chosen. {change}
S78-SELECTION-PRICE-DRIFT.why: A buyer is never charged a changed amount without seeing it first.
S78-SELECTION-PRICE-DRIFT.fix: Show the buyer the new price and ask them to confirm it.
choices: I show the buyer the new price and ask them to confirm.
I put the old price back if the change was a mistake (you approve it first).

S78-SELECTION-TENANT-MISMATCH.what_happened: A choice from a different business or launch was sent to this checkout.
S78-SELECTION-TENANT-MISMATCH.why: Each business keeps its own buyers and prices. One business's checkout never uses another's.
S78-SELECTION-TENANT-MISMATCH.fix: Start the choice again from this launch's own page.
choices: I send the buyer back to the right page to choose again.
I check that every link on your page points to your own checkout.

S78-SELECTION-STALE-REVISION.what_happened: Your launch plan was updated after this choice was made, so the choice is out of date.
S78-SELECTION-STALE-REVISION.why: A buyer must see the current terms before paying, never old ones.
S78-SELECTION-STALE-REVISION.fix: Show the buyer the current terms and ask them to confirm.
choices: I show the buyer the current terms and ask them to confirm.
I rebuild the page from your newest plan.

S78-QUERY-PRICE-AUTHORITY.what_happened: A web link tried to set the price or the package by itself (for example by adding "price=" to the address).
S78-QUERY-PRICE-AUTHORITY.why: Anyone can type into a web address. If a link could set the price, a buyer could change $197 to $1. Prices come only from your approved plan.
S78-QUERY-PRICE-AUTHORITY.fix: Use the normal page link. Prices load from your plan by themselves.
choices: I take the price part out of the link and give you the clean link.
I check every link on your page for this.

S78-BINDING-INCOMPLETE.what_happened: The checkout links for your packages are not complete. {missing}
S78-BINDING-INCOMPLETE.why: Each package price needs its own checkout link, so a buyer who picks it pays exactly that amount. We stop until every link is right.
S78-BINDING-INCOMPLETE.fix: Create or link the missing checkout page, then build the links again.
choices: I set up the missing checkout links (I ask your OK before anything is installed).
I list which prices are missing a link.

S78-BINDING-SHARED-TARGET.what_happened: Two different package prices point to the same checkout page.
S78-BINDING-SHARED-TARGET.why: If two prices share one checkout page, a buyer could pay the wrong price.
S78-BINDING-SHARED-TARGET.fix: Give each price its own checkout page.
choices: I give each price its own checkout page and check again.
I show you which two prices are sharing.

S78-BINDING-DUPLICATE-TARGET.what_happened: One package price has two checkout pages.
S78-BINDING-DUPLICATE-TARGET.why: Each price must lead to exactly one checkout page, so the buyer's path is clear.
S78-BINDING-DUPLICATE-TARGET.fix: Keep one checkout page and remove the other.
choices: I keep one and remove the extra, then check again.
I show you both so you can choose which one stays.

S78-BINDING-TARGET-DRIFT.what_happened: A checkout page points to a different product or price than your approved plan.
S78-BINDING-TARGET-DRIFT.why: The checkout must charge exactly the approved product and price.
S78-BINDING-TARGET-DRIFT.fix: Link that checkout page to the approved product and price again.
choices: I link it again and check it.
I show you both so you can say which one is right.

S78-BINDING-NOT-ALLOWLISTED.what_happened: A checkout page is not on your list of approved checkout pages.
S78-BINDING-NOT-ALLOWLISTED.why: Only checkout pages you approved may take payments, so a buyer is never sent somewhere unknown.
S78-BINDING-NOT-ALLOWLISTED.fix: Approve that checkout page, or use an approved one.
choices: I switch it to one of your approved checkout pages.
I send that checkout page to you to approve.

S78-RUNTIME-BAD-REQUEST.what_happened: The choose page got a request it could not read.
S78-RUNTIME-BAD-REQUEST.why: When something does not make sense, the page stops instead of guessing, so it never picks a package or a price by mistake.
S78-RUNTIME-BAD-REQUEST.fix: Send the request again with the missing details.
choices: I check what was missing and send it again.
I send the buyer back to the page to choose again.

S78-RUNTIME-UNKNOWN-ACTION.what_happened: The choose page was asked to do something it does not know how to do.
S78-RUNTIME-UNKNOWN-ACTION.why: When something does not make sense, the page stops instead of guessing, so it never picks a package or a price by mistake.
S78-RUNTIME-UNKNOWN-ACTION.fix: Use one of the page's normal steps.
choices: I find the right step and run it.
I report it to support so it gets fixed.

S78-SESSION-STORAGE.what_happened: The buyer's choice could not be saved.
S78-SESSION-STORAGE.why: A choice that is not saved safely would vanish if the system restarts, so we stop instead of pretending it was saved.
S78-SESSION-STORAGE.fix: Try saving again. If it keeps failing, the storage needs a check.
choices: I try again now.
I check the storage space and settings, then try again.
I ask the buyer to choose again in a few minutes.

S78-SESSION-EXPIRED.what_happened: Your package choice timed out, so nothing was picked for you.
S78-SESSION-EXPIRED.why: We never choose a package for you. A choice is only saved for a short time to keep your order safe.
S78-SESSION-EXPIRED.fix: Look at the packages and choose again.
choices: We take you back to the packages now, so you can choose again.
We help you compare the packages before you choose.
Go back to the packages and choose on your own.

S78-SESSION-RECONFIRM.what_happened: The price or terms of {offer} changed after you picked it. {change}
S78-SESSION-RECONFIRM.why: You will never be charged a changed amount without seeing it and saying yes first.
S78-SESSION-RECONFIRM.fix: Look at the new terms and confirm them, or pick a different package.
choices: We show you the new terms next to the old ones, and you say yes before anything goes on.
Confirm the new terms and keep going.
Pick a different package.

S78-IMAGES-INPUTS-NONE.what_happened: The pictures step was told to skip this page's wireframes and mockups.
S78-IMAGES-INPUTS-NONE.why: Every funnel with a choose page gets its wireframes and mockups. Skipping them would leave the page with no design.
S78-IMAGES-INPUTS-NONE.fix: Run the pictures step with its normal settings file.
choices: I run the pictures step with the right settings.
I show you which settings it needs.

S78-IMAGES-INPUTS-MISSING.what_happened: The pictures step is missing settings it needs, like your brand file or your picture limit.
S78-IMAGES-INPUTS-MISSING.why: Pictures must use your own brand colors and stay under your picture limit, so the step stops when those are missing.
choices: I fill in the missing settings from your brand file and try again.
I ask you for anything I cannot find.

S78-IMAGES-PLAN-NOT-BUILT.what_happened: There is no choose page to draw, because the plan did not build one (for example, there is only one package).
S78-IMAGES-PLAN-NOT-BUILT.why: We only draw pages that are really in your funnel.
S78-IMAGES-PLAN-NOT-BUILT.fix: Build the plan first, or skip pictures for this page.
choices: I build the plan first, then draw the page.
I skip this page's pictures because there is no choose page.

S78-IMAGES-PAID-NOT-ALLOWED.what_happened: The pictures were set to use the paid picture service, but nobody said yes to spending money.
S78-IMAGES-PAID-NOT-ALLOWED.why: Money is only spent after you say yes. The system never decides to spend on its own.
S78-IMAGES-PAID-NOT-ALLOWED.fix: Say yes to the paid run, or use the free practice pictures.
choices: I run the free practice version now, at no cost.
I ask you to approve the paid run, then run it.
match: is a paid route and needs --allow-paid

S78-IMAGES-BOARD-APPROVAL-WAIT.what_happened: The final mockups are waiting for you to approve the design board.
S78-IMAGES-BOARD-APPROVAL-WAIT.why: Final mockups cost money and are built on top of the design board. We wait for your yes, so we never pay for a look you have not approved.
S78-IMAGES-BOARD-APPROVAL-WAIT.fix: Look at the design board and approve it, or ask for changes.
choices: I send you the design board to look at now.
I make the changes you want, then send it to you again.
I wait until you are ready.
match: no client approval recorded for this page's board

S78-IMAGES-BOARD-SPEC-MISSING.what_happened: The design board step is missing your brand facts.
S78-IMAGES-BOARD-SPEC-MISSING.why: The design board shows your real brand, so it cannot be made without your brand facts.
S78-IMAGES-BOARD-SPEC-MISSING.fix: Add your brand facts for the board.
choices: I gather your brand facts from your brand file and try again.
I ask you for the facts I cannot find.

S78-IMAGES-DEPENDENCY-MISSING.what_happened: The picture step could not start, because a helper program it needs is not installed on this computer.
S78-IMAGES-DEPENDENCY-MISSING.why: The picture step draws the wireframes and mockups, and it needs that helper to draw anything. It stops instead of failing halfway through your pages.
S78-IMAGES-DEPENDENCY-MISSING.fix: Install the missing helper on this computer, then run the page again.
choices: I install the missing helper and run the page again.
I run the free practice version first once the helper is installed.
I tell you what is missing and wait for your decision.

S78-IMAGES-STEP-FAILED.what_happened: One of the picture steps stopped before it finished.
S78-IMAGES-STEP-FAILED.why: Each step checks its own work. When one fails, the next ones stop, so nothing is built on a broken step. A later step is not started on top of a failure, and this run is not treated as a finished page.
S78-IMAGES-STEP-FAILED.fix: Find the step that stopped, fix that one thing, and run the page again.
choices: I find what stopped it, fix it, and run the page again.
I run the free practice version first to test it.
I explain the problem to you in plain words before I change anything.
